detailed_description:

Global rules: no wide or medium-full framing — every shot is waist-up or closer so <Subject 1>'s face stays sharply in focus; no dialogue; the black leather newsboy cap stays on her head throughout and is never removed; the silver chain belt stays around her waist; her right hand is free to gesture and her left hand may rest in the cargo pocket; the Christmas tree, candy cane, "LOCAL" letters, stone building, and stone pavement layout of <Subject 2> stay locked; distant tourists remain tiny, blurred, and nearly still; no extra handheld props appear; the "LOCAL" lettering and the vertical Chinese signs retain their original spelling and stay legible.
[Shot 1] The video opens on a medium waist-up handheld shot: <Subject 1> stands in the alley of <Subject 2>, the glowing pink Christmas tree rising softly out of focus behind her shoulder. Her right hand lifts to rest lightly on the brim of her black leather newsboy cap, fingertips tapping the edge once in her signature pose; her left hand hangs relaxed at her side. She looks straight at the lens with a quiet, cool expression. The warm tree lights flicker as soft bokeh dots around her. End state: <Subject 1> standing, right hand on the cap brim, looking at the lens.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to a slightly tighter medium shot. <Subject 1> lowers her right hand from the cap and tilts her chin up to gaze at the Christmas tree lights beside her, her eyes softening as she follows the warm fairy lights upward to the glowing star on top. Her left hand slips into her cargo pocket. The blue dusk sky glows behind her. End state: <Subject 1> standing, head tilted up at the tree, left hand in pocket.
[Shot 3] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a medium shot. <Subject 1> turns her body to a three-quarter angle toward the candy-cane wall, her right hand now also slipping into the opposite cargo pocket, shoulders relaxed, weight resting on one hip. She lets out a small breath and a faint closed-lip smile, eyes drifting sideways along the wall-mounted red-white candy cane. End state: <Subject 1> three-quarter to the wall, both hands in pockets, faint smile.
[Shot 4] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a closer medium shot. <Subject 1> turns her head back over her shoulder toward the camera in a small half-turn, her eyes meeting the lens with a quiet glance; she lifts her right hand out of her pocket to lightly adjust the brim of the leather cap once more. The golden "LOCAL" letters glow softly out of focus behind her. End state: <Subject 1> half-turned over her shoulder, hand on cap brim, eyes on the lens.
[Shot 5] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a quiet close-up framed from the chest up. <Subject 1> lowers her right hand out of frame; a strand of bob hair drifts across her cheek in the light evening breeze. Her cool expression softens into a gentle closed-lip smile, and she gives a tiny head tilt to one side, warm Christmas-light bokeh glowing behind her, holding this quiet expression until the final frame. End state: still close-up, eyes on the lens, soft smile.

overall_soundscape:
Dusk old-town alley ambience: a faint cool evening breeze, distant muffled chatter of the few tourists, soft footstep scuffs on the stone pavement, a low hum of the Christmas-tree fairy lights, and far-off city traffic. No voices directed at the camera.

non_diegetic_music:
